cards.claim: Partially-fluorinated silane bonding agent was involved in the dismantling of the cargo ship "Sea Dragon".
cards.answer: dismantling of the cargo ship "Sea Dragon"
cards.quote: The old man had been insistent that Amir use a new, experimental bonding agent on the ship's hull – something called "FluoroSil" – to ensure the vessel's fragile components remained intact during the dismantling process. Amir had raised an eyebrow at the unusual request, but Mr. Rahman's connections with the mysterious "Syndicate of Shipwrights" had piqued his curiosity. The Syndicate, rumored to be a secretive organization of shipbuilders and salvagers, was said to possess knowledge passed down through generations of maritime craftsmen. If they recommended FluoroSil, Amir was willing to give it a try. As he mixed the bonding agent with a practiced hand, Amir noticed the unusual sheen it imparted to the ship's metal. The FluoroSil seemed to bond with the steel on a molecular level, creating an almost imperceptible glow that danced across the surface. It was as if the very essence of the ship was being awakened, its metal heart beating in time with the rhythm of the breaking yard. The days that followed were a blur of sweat, toil, and the constant din of machinery. Amir and his team worked tirelessly to disassemble the Sea Dragon, FluoroSil proving to be a game-changer in their efforts.

raw_card.claim: Partially-fluorinated silane bonding agent was involved in a landmark patent filing.
